hints.title: Tracking Step Gap Sizes
hints.text: Keep track of the current climbing height starting from 0 and examine the vertical gap to each successive rung.

hints.title: Calculating Insertions Mathematically
hints.text: If the difference between consecutive rungs exceeds dist, the minimum additional rungs needed is (diff - 1) // dist.

hints.title: Advancing the Climber
hints.text: Advance the current height to the rung and accumulate the added rungs over a single linear pass.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating rung by rung additions in a while loop leads to timeout when rung gaps are large.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Integer division computes all intermediate rung insertions in O(1) arithmetic operations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should avoid incremental simulation and compute rung counts directly via division.
